settings.title: Nurturing Agriculture, Empowering Success
settings.description:
TAK provides premium dried fruits, nuts, and natural ingredients from Afghanistan. Certified BRC, Organic, and Kosher, our advanced facility preserves natural taste and nutrition.

We work directly with local farmers for fair trade and full traceability, serving clients across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and North America with quality and trust.

settings.title: Our History
settings.description:
TAK was founded in 2014 to export premium Afghan dry fruits and strengthen the country’s agriculture sector. Our modern facility in Mazar-e-Sharif uses international-standard machinery for cleaning, sorting, and packaging.

We employ over 100 skilled workers, including many women, and export to Russia, the USA, Europe, Turkey, and the UAE. As an FDA-registered company, we maintain strict global food safety standards.

settings.title: Our Vision
settings.description:
TAK is committed to Afghanistan’s sustainable growth by using its expertise in agriculture and trade. We focus on creating value, generating jobs, and supporting local communities. Through responsible practices and strong export networks, we promote Afghan products globally and strengthen the country’s economic foundation.
  • Creating meaningful job opportunities for the Afghan people
  • Delivering high-quality, globally standardized products
  • Setting a benchmark as a leader in the dry fruit industry
